DoraPDF / Privacy Policy

Privacy Policy

Last updated: November 8, 2026

This Privacy Policy explains how DoraPDF ("we", "us", "our"), available at dorapdf.com, handles information when you use our website and tools. DoraPDF is operated by Phyntx, Pakistan.

1. Your files stay on your device

DoraPDF's tools run inside your web browser. When you convert, compress, merge, scan, edit or otherwise process a file, the processing happens on your own device. Your files are not uploaded to or stored on our servers, and we cannot see their contents. When you close or refresh the page, the files are gone from the tool.

Some tools load helper code (open-source software libraries) from trusted content delivery networks such as cdnjs.cloudflare.com and cdn.jsdelivr.net. These providers receive standard technical information (such as your IP address) needed to deliver the code, but they never receive your files.

2. Information we collect

The file tools never need an account. If you use the Assignment Helper, you sign in with Google. We then receive and store your name, email address and profile picture from Google, your plan and usage counts (how many assignments and presentations you created), the date of your last sign-in and basic device information (browser type) used to keep one active session per account. The topic and instructions you type are sent to our AI provider (Cloudflare Workers AI) to generate your document; we do not store the generated text on our servers. Reference images you attach stay in your browser and are not uploaded. If you pay by JazzCash, Easypaisa or NayaPay, we store the transaction ID and amount you enter so we can confirm your payment. If you pay by card or PayPal, the payment is handled by Paddle.com (our Merchant of Record); Paddle collects your payment and billing details under its own privacy policy, and we only receive your email, plan and payment status. You can ask us to delete your account at any time by emailing hello@dorapdf.com.

We do not collect your phone number or other personal details unless you contact us yourself.

We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use the site — for example, which tools are popular, which pages are visited, the approximate country and the type of device and browser. Google Analytics uses cookies and similar technologies and processes data such as your IP address, which Google may truncate. We use this information only in aggregate to improve DoraPDF. You can learn more at How Google uses information from sites that use its services and opt out with the Google Analytics Opt-out Browser Add-on.

Our hosting and security provider, Cloudflare, processes technical information such as IP addresses to deliver the website and protect it from abuse.

3. Cookies and local storage

  • Analytics cookies set by Google Analytics, as described above.
  • Advertising cookies — see section 4.
  • Local storage in your browser to remember simple preferences such as light/dark theme and sound effects. This information never leaves your device.

You can delete cookies and local storage at any time in your browser settings.

4. Advertising

We may display advertisements served by Google AdSense to keep DoraPDF free.

  • Third-party vendors, including Google, use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this website or other websites.
  • Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads to you based on your visits to this and/or other sites on the Internet.
  • You may opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google Ads Settings. You can also opt out of some third-party vendors' use of cookies for personalised advertising at aboutads.info.

Where required by law (for example in the EEA and UK), we will ask for your consent before personalised ads or non-essential cookies are used.

5. Children

DoraPDF is a general-audience website and is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

6. Data security

Because files are processed on your device and are not uploaded, the risk to your documents is minimal. Our website is served over HTTPS with modern security headers.

7. Your rights

Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct or delete personal data, or to object to its processing. As we hold very little personal data, most requests relate to analytics or advertising data held by Google — see the links above. For anything else, contact us at hello@dorapdf.com.

8. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top shows when it was last changed.

9. Contact

Questions about this policy? Email hello@dorapdf.com or visit our contact page.
